citations.title: A Stereoscopic Look into the Bulk
Equivalence of Emergent de Sitter Spaces from Conformal Field Theory

claims.statement: Tensor-network, integral-geometric, and OPE-block constructions provide distinct tests and interpretations of kinematic organization rather than one interchangeable result.
claims.scope: the holographic models and approximation regimes treated by the sources

claims.statement: Thermal states, quotients, and phase behavior can change accessible branches and the global kinematic description.
claims.scope: the selected three-dimensional gravity and CFT cases analyzed by the source

claims.statement: MERA adjacency is evidence about a discretized space of intervals or geodesics and must not automatically be read as adjacency of bulk points.
claims.scope: the proposed structural correspondence rather than all tensor networks

limitations: The assay does not prove a no-go theorem for systems outside the cited constructions.
Open questions are framed as missing maps or tests and are not reported as established results.
Vacuum smoothness, minimal branches, and leading semiclassical limits may hide reconstruction failures.
